row.title: The seed asked a hosted owner for cloud and model keys
row.body: Walking the policy atlas idea through the seed's bootstrap opened cards asking the owner to set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and to approve spending. A person with no code agent cannot do that. IDEA.md now takes hosted_by; the host deploys and binds models and the bootstrap opens no secret or budget card (HOSTED-1).

title: The seed asked a hosted owner for cloud and model keys
